stage1.impression: A three-quarter view of the carton speaker on a warm grey sweep, with the product in the right third, the left half kept for copy, and the red and printed marks reading clearly. The light is flat and frontal: the large white planes sit close in value, the floor shadow is soft and weak, the sweep is a drab mid-grey and the product sits low, so it reads as a competent CG draft rather than a hero.

blocking_9: The amp plate reads as dark anodised metal: part:amp-plate median 62-78 with a soft sheen (now 99.5, rgb [100, 99, 103], a mid-grey slab).
The connections read as hardware at 100%: the IEC inlet and the round socket carry edge highlights, part:amp-connectors p95 >= 105 (now 70.4; only the RCA, p95 185.6, catches light).
The side plane sits 35-45 levels below the back, and the plinth turns the corner the same way (now part medians 204 vs 229; the plinth's side face is 78-79 against its back face at 72-78).
The plinth band has the fin's hue and chroma and is darker only by the falloff, with no floor veil: side face G <= 46 (now 58), chroma >= 55 (now 48), hue about 33 degrees like the fin (now 28).
At least 95 px of floor below the near base corner and at least 80 px above the fin (now 77 and 114).
A tight contact line where the plinth meets the floor: the floor within 4 px of the base at <= 0.75 of the floor 40 px out (now about 0.89 at the near corner, 148-152 against 166-169).
No legible mirror image of OPEN OTHER SIDE on the roof just under the fin (rows 147-151 show letter peaks of 99-108 over a roof at 86-96).

changes.problem: The amplifier plate reads as a flat mid-grey slab rather than black anodised aluminium, because glint 1 (0.3 m, 1 W) lifts the whole plate, and last round's tuning stopped at 1 W, above its own 50-75 target.

evidence.measured: part:amp-plate lum_median 99.5 (p5 80.4, p95 109.8), rgb [100, 99, 103]; profile y 106.8 to 78.5. Last round's proofs (1 W gave 100.6, 1.86 W gave 124.9, 3 W gave 149.9) are linear in scene-linear light, about 0.088 per W on a base of about 0.042, so about 0.2 W lands near 69.

changes.expected: part:amp-plate median about 69 (p5 about 62, p95 about 74): a dark anodised plate with a faint sheen toward its upper right. The screws (112), the gold RCA and the LED stand out against it. The dark connectors (53) sit about 15 levels below it, which c4 offsets.

changes.problem: The side plane is too close in value to the back, so the carton reads soft and high-key rather than solid, and the plinth band's two faces have the same value.

evidence.measured: Part medians: side-right 204.0, back-panel 229.3. In 90 px bands from y 245 to 700, the side strip x746-762 runs 206.6 to 195.9 and the back strip x886-905 runs 244.4 to 229.8: a 34-38 level step, about 0.5 stop. The plinth's side face is 78.5-79.0 across (profile x745-873, y745-765) and its back face 72.5-77.8 (x885-1075, y770-782, text aside).

changes.expected: part:side-right median about 190 (from 204). At the shared corner the side falls to about 193-182 against the back's 244-230, a step of about 48 levels. The side's far edge stays about 18-28 levels above the wall behind it (173-154). The plinth's side face drops to about 70-73, below its back face, so the band turns the corner like the body. The floor left of the side darkens a few levels.

changes.problem: The product sits low, with 77 px of floor below the near base corner against 114 px above the fin, so the floor contact and its shadow are cramped against the bottom edge.

evidence.measured: Fin top at y 114 (gable-block box). Near base corner at y 820-823 (back-panel and side-right boxes). The contact shadow below the corner (profile x860-890, y818-900) rises 150.1 to 180.1 and is still rising at the frame's edge.

changes.expected: With the level camera, the lens shift lifts everything by about 25 px: fin top at about y 89, near base corner at about y 796, leaving about 104 px of floor and the whole contact shadow below the base. The test strip at the near corner goes from mostly plinth (mean 89.9) to about half floor (mean about 130). The bounds allow a lift of about 17-31 px.

changes.problem: The connections read as dark specks: glint 0 was skipped because its point lands on the round socket, whose surface there mirrors amp-module, so only the gold RCA catches light.

evidence.measured: Glint 0 at [0.54, -0.11, 0.19] projects to about x 1032, y 671 (the round socket's ring). amp-connectors median 53.1, p95 70.4; amp-switch p95 55.4; amp-module p95 56.4; amp-rca p95 185.6. The IEC inlet's frame (amp-connectors pixels at x 1041-1064, y 659-682) faces the back's normal and mirrors open space to the right (about az 73, el 12).

changes.expected: The new point projects to about x 1062, y 667, on the right bar of the IEC inlet's frame. A small specular highlight there takes amp-connectors p95 from 70.4 to about 120-170, so the inlet reads as a framed socket beside the RCA on the darker plate.

changes.problem: The plinth band's red is veiled toward a dusty pink because its clear coat mirrors the lit floor within about 0.45 m of the base, while the fin, in the same paint and mirroring the dim far set, is on colour.

evidence.measured: Plinth side face (side-right pixels): rgb [160, 58, 57], dE2000 8.25 against #C62828, chroma 48 against 72.5, hue 28 against 33.8. Back face {back-panel in [1030,752,1070,778]}: rgb [168, 50, 50], dE2000 6.19. Fin [809,116,826,146]: dE2000 0.96. G and B are lifted from 40 to 50-58, a neutral veil (about 0.029 linear on the side face, 0.018 on the back). The floor beside the base is 155-181.

to.what: matte black reflection card (a CG flag), seen only in glossy reflections on the receivers; invisible to camera, diffuse and shadow rays and to the sweep's own reflections

changes.expected: The floor veil on the plinth drops to about a quarter. Side face from [160, 58, 57] to about [150, 36, 36] (chroma 48 to about 55, hue 28 to about 33 degrees like the fin). Back face from [168, 50, 50] to about [166, 38, 38]. The band reads as the fin's red in shade rather than pink-brown. Its dE stays near 6-9 because the plinth sits low in the light's falloff, which is right for a lower, shaded face. The lower white body loses an invisible 2-3 levels of floor reflection.

out_of_scope.request: Frame the amp plate larger so the connectors (68 x 25 px; the RCA 9 x 8 px) can be read.
out_of_scope.why: This frame must hold the whole object, its floor contact and the copy space at a fixed frame size. Legible connections need their own detail frame.

out_of_scope.request: Silkscreen legends on the amp plate (inputs, power, LED).
out_of_scope.why: They would make the cluster read as an amplifier at a glance, but the plate's markings belong to the product, which is fixed.

out_of_scope.request: Remove the mirrored fin lettering on the roof by lowering the fin, changing the pitch or dulling the clear coat.
out_of_scope.why: The fin and the 37.6 degree roof are the spec, and the clear coat's gloss is the product's finish. No modest camera move removes it: the camera would have to look down on the roof by about 15 degrees. The reflection is physically correct, so if the client objects it is a retouch.
